title: Maria B
content: My grandmother had recently died. I had strangely felt the need to go to church for her. I went to pray on the day of her death and the following days. One night, I found myself catapulted into a tunnel made of concentric circles with a gray background. From each of the circles, emanated an immensely warm and loving light. It was very white but not blinding. In this dream, I was spirit and eyes. I was also fused with the spirit of my grandmother; it was as if we were intimately arm in arm. At the end of the tunnel the circle became very small. I knew that the road in the tunnel was very long and far away from us. In the center of that small circle was an individual waiting for me. I saw a stylized man-like shape. He was gray in color but transparent. I accompanied her on her journey and we knew that he was waiting for us. I knew that it was not Jesus, but was like an assistant. He waved and moved while waiting for our arrival. Time did not exist there. Even the space was different; we walked and never moved forward. We had been there for a long time; but it was as if time never passed. It seemed like an eternal moment as if time did not pass. at every step there were some kind of chimes, and I heard wonderful music they seemed like angels to me. I was perfectly aware of what was happening in the dream; that is, I was accompanying my grandmother for a little while on her journey. I knew everything I was experiencing and I didn't ask myself questions. Then I woke up. If I had to summarize my experience with just one word I would say 'LOVE.' It was an experience of indescribable love. I felt peace, serenity, relaxation, and comfort. But above all, I felt love. It was a different love that was not even comparable to maternal love. This love is not describable with earthly words. I was in a dimension of peace and love.
